After that, ensure that the portal within the parlor is open. And then, make an attempt to venture west. If you can finish that, attempt to head north. Following that, move west. And then, go west. After that, move west. Once you succeed at that, travel south. Once you manage that, go to the east. With that done, take a trip east. And then, lift the latchkey from the floor of the laundromat. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
